plan.title: USER.md / user-config resolution in mismatched + headless envs

narratives.Description: Resolve USER.md / user-config automatically in mismatched and headless environments so session-start no longer requires a manual DEFT_USER_PATH. A new shared resolver walks an explicit first-hit-wins search order (DEFT_USER_PATH override, then a workspace-local bridged config, then the bridged platform config dir, then a sensible default with a clear diagnostic), session-start consumes it so agentic sandboxes where $HOME is not persistent still find preferences, and the resolved path is surfaced in diagnostics and doctor rather than crashing when nothing is found.
narratives.Overview:
Part of epic #2203 (Decision 7).

## Summary

Resolve USER.md / user-config automatically in mismatched and headless environments so session-start does not require a manual `DEFT_USER_PATH`. In agentic sandboxes `$HOME` is often not under a persistent mount, so the default `~/.config/deft/USER.md` is absent (reproduced in the #2124 Cowork session).

## Behavior

Resolve USER.md across an explicit search order, first hit wins:

1. `DEFT_USER_PATH` (explicit override) — unchanged, highest precedence.
2. Workspace-local user config (a bridged, persistent location inside the workspace).
3. Bridged platform config dir (`%APPDATA%\deft\USER.md` / `~/.config/deft/USER.md`) when reachable.
4. Sensible default + a clear "no USER.md found; using defaults" diagnostic (never a hard failure).

Diagnostics state which path was resolved, so the boundary is visible.

## Acceptance criteria

- Session-start resolves USER.md with zero manual `DEFT_USER_PATH` when a bridged config exists.
- Search order honored; `DEFT_USER_PATH` still wins.
- Missing USER.md degrades to defaults with a clear diagnostic, not a crash.
- Resolved path surfaced in diagnostics / `doctor`.
- Tests cover each search-order branch + the absent-everywhere fallback.

## Related

Parent #2203. Sibling of the out-of-scope SCM/gh auth follow-up (same "environment resource in a sandbox" family).
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive agent starting a session in a mismatched or headless sandbox where $HOME is not persistent, I want USER.md resolved automatically across an explicit first-hit-wins search order with the resolved path surfaced in diagnostics, so that session-start finds my preferences without a manual DEFT_USER_PATH and degrades to defaults with a clear message instead of crashing when none exists.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Add a new shared resolver `packages/core/src/user-config/resolve-user-md.ts` implementing the first-hit-wins search order: (1) DEFT_USER_PATH override, (2) workspace-local bridged config, (3) bridged platform config dir (%APPDATA%/deft or ~/.config/deft), (4) sensible default + a `no USER.md found; using defaults` diagnostic (never throws). Return the resolved path + which rung matched. Export it from `packages/core/src/index.ts`.
2. Consume the resolver in `packages/core/src/session/session-start.ts` so the session-start alignment step resolves USER.md automatically (fixes the #2124 Cowork gap) and records which path was used, with zero manual DEFT_USER_PATH when a bridged config exists.
3. Rewire the bootstrap USER.md resolution `resolveBootstrapUserMdPath()` in `packages/cli/src/dispatch.ts` to delegate to the shared resolver (single source), preserving DEFT_USER_PATH precedence.
4. Surface the resolved path (and the using-defaults diagnostic) in `packages/core/src/doctor/main.ts` so the resolution boundary is visible in doctor output. Keep strictly to this surface: do NOT touch init-deposit.ts (its inline userConfigDir consumer swap is a deliberate follow-up, owned away from concurrent sibling #2268), init-cli, xbrief-migrate, or resolution/plan.ts.
5. Colocated vitest in `resolve-user-md.test.ts` covering each search-order rung + the absent-everywhere fallback, plus session-start + dispatch + doctor consumption tests. Add a brief CHANGELOG entry. Run `task ts:check-lane`, targeted vitest, and `task check:framework-source`.
